method: Native phrase timestamps from local multilingual Whisper-small, focused retries and FFmpeg measured speech/pause regions (-34dB/min70ms). Caption timing follows actual phrases, not uniform intervals.
visualSubsteps: Color/font/layout transitions subdivide one measured continuous phrase; no word-level timestamp accuracy claimed. Archive mouths are original performances under recap narration, not new lip-sync.
